recognize_zh: 高倍下小腸絨毛固有層充滿中型、核深染不規則的非典型淋巴球，並大量進入表面上皮使上皮變得空泡化、排列紊亂，這種上皮親和性的 T 細胞浸潤是腸病相關 T 細胞淋巴瘤的重要線索。
features: Dense lamina propria infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphocytes
Hyperchromatic, irregular to angulated nuclei with scant cytoplasm
Prominent intraepithelial infiltration by atypical cells
Dilated congested capillaries within villous cores
describe_en: Section of small-intestinal mucosa at high power shows villous cores densely infiltrated by medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Many atypical cells infiltrate the surface epithelium, which is vacuolated and disrupted. Dilated congested capillaries are seen within the villi, without a prominent mixed inflammatory component. Findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma; confirmation by T-cell immunophenotyping (CD3+, often CD4-/CD8-, CD56-, CD30 variable) is recommended.

ddx.vs: MEITL cells are monomorphic with pale cytoplasm and express CD8, CD56 and often MATK, whereas EATL is typically CD56 negative with more pleomorphism.
RCD II intraepithelial lymphocytes are small and cytologically bland despite an aberrant phenotype, without a destructive lamina propria infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving bowel
ddx.vs: ALCL is composed of large hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30, often ALK positive.
